summary: Full E2E test of image thumbnail system + logo shape / header colour / new backdrops batch. Backend 11/12 pytest (1 minor cache-control issue caused by middleware). Frontend fully verified: all new data-testids present, save flow succeeds, public booking page renders light-golden header + square plaque logo + champagne gold backdrop, Services page fires /api/files/{id}?w=160 requests as expected.

minor.issue: Route sets 'Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable' but a global response middleware overwrites it with 'no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate'. This defeats the browser-cache purpose of the thumbnail system — every visit will re-download the WEBP (still cheaper server-side thanks to the storage-cached webp, but bandwidth savings are lost). Suggest whitelisting /api/files/* and /api/img from the no-store middleware.

action_items: OPTIONAL PERF: whitelist /api/files/* and /api/img from the no-store cache-control middleware so the 1-year immutable header actually reaches the browser and short-circuits repeat downloads of the WEBP variants.
critical_code_review_comments: uploads.py _resize_webp: image opened without a max-pixel guard; a 20k x 20k pixel bomb PNG under 3 MB would still consume gigs of RAM during resize. Consider PIL Image.MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS or a bounds check before resize.

uploads.py /api/img: requests.get(src, timeout=12) executes synchronously in a thread — acceptable, but no size cap on the response; a malicious allowlisted upload path (if ever compromised) could return an arbitrarily large body. Consider streaming with size cap.
uploads.py /files/{id}?w=: cache-write via asyncio.ensure_future without exception logging — silent failures possible. Attach a done_callback logging exceptions.
seed_data_creation: test_thumbs_branding.py uploads a test PNG each module run under kind=service (small; not deleted — harmless). Branding restored to logo_shape=square, header_bg=#F3E5BF, book_bg=img:champagne at end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_thumbs_branding.py (12 tests). Covers thumbnail resize, SSRF allowlist, branding logo_shape / header_bg validation, public salon payload. All pass except immutable cache-control assertion (middleware override — see backend_issues.minor).
rca of the issue: Cache-Control override: the FastAPI app registers a middleware that force-sets 'no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate' on every response for security (typical for auth-sensitive JSON APIs). It is applied indiscriminately including to /api/files and /api/img which set their own long-lived Cache-Control. Fix: in the middleware, skip overriding when the response's Content-Type starts with 'image/' or when path starts with /api/files or /api/img.
